text:
sana: onboarding peregrine15b-int4 canary today. getting sporadic OOMs under websocket burst tests and a small drop in long-form accuracy vs fp16. any ideas?
leo: saw the failures. pattern: sessions with long interactive turns + function calls. OOMs usually when max_new_tokens > 180 or when we pad batches to 32. suspect kv fragmentation + allocator slab granularity for int4.
tammy: example failure log:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA OOM when allocating tensor of size 1.28 GiB (GPU 0; 80.00 GiB total capacity; 70.4 GiB already allocated)
  at runtime/slab_allocator.cpp:243
  slab: reserved 4.8 GiB, used 31.6 GiB, fragmented_free: 2.6 GiB
```
isabel: low-effort mitigations to try: lower defaults, special-case tool-calling sessions, enable kv_compact_on_idle, and reduce pad_to for adaptive batching. proposed quick patch: 
```yaml
models:
  peregrine15b-int4:
    default_batch_size: 1
    default_max_new_tokens: 120
    prefetch_window: 8
    kv_compact_on_idle: true
    adaptive_batching: {min:1, max:3, pad_to:8}
    slab_reserve_ratio: 0.06
```
sana: rolling that to canary-1 now. will run the websocket burst harness and regen evals.
leo: also add runtime telemetry: emit slab.fragment_pct, kv.free_frag_bytes, and percent_requests_with_tool_calls. that'll help correlate.
tammy: quick smoke (40 websocket sessions) with the patch: no OOMs, memory peak down ~4.7 GiB, but Rouge-L down 2.1 on long prompts. quality hit concentrated on multi-hop reasoning chains.
isabel: quality regression likely from quantization + kv trimming changing logits for long contexts. next experiments: 1) run per-channel calibration for int4, 2) try hybrid attention in fp16 with int4 weights, 3) increase slab_reserve_ratio to 0.10 for canary-dedicated.
sana: starting a 2k-step calibration job (per-channel) and scheduling a hybrid build compile. also creating a service route: if request.meta.tool_calls >= 1 or request.session_length > 1200 -> route to peregrine15b-int4-dedicated with slab_reserve_ratio: 0.10. docs will temporarily expose customer_max_new_tokens=140.
oncall-bot: deploy roll started: peregrine15b-int4 config -> canary-1. CI smoke queued.
leo: follow-ups: add alert when 95p slab.fragment_pct > 12% and emit histogram of max_new_tokens per session. if calibration doesn't recover quality, fallback: hybrid fp16-attention.
tammy: note: slab defrag during low-traffic windows recovered ~1.5 GiB of usable free memory in previous experiments. schedule defrag 02:00-03:00.
sana: assigning leo/tammy to run eval comparisons (PPL, Rouge-L, hallucination rate) and check telemetry after 24h of canary traffic. will post results here. :thumbsup:
